E0414

Redundant `pub` inside a `#PubFile` file (D-VISDEFAULT2)

What

Redundant `pub` inside a `#PubFile` file (D-VISDEFAULT2)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0414

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0414: tests/ui/pub_file_redundant_pub.stderr.

Error [E0414]: `pub` is redundant in a `#PubFile` file
  --> tests/ui/pub_file_redundant_pub.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | pub fn greet() => String :: "hi"
    | ^^^
 Why: after `#PubFile`, top-level items are already public unless marked `priv`
 Fix: drop `pub` or mark exceptions with `priv`
